{
  "title": "Remedy for a Substantial Procedural Error",
  "setting": "An Army investigation or board under AR 15–6, 22 June 2025.",
  "decider": "The approval authority",
  "agent_recast": false,
  "recast_note": "",
  "agent": "The approval authority",
  "agent_role": "decide",
  "situation": "An investigation or board contains an error that materially adversely affects an individual’s substantial rights. The approval authority must determine whether the error can be corrected without substantial prejudice to the individual. Returning the case for correction entails notifying affected respondents of the error and proposed correction and giving them the right to comment. If the error cannot be corrected without substantial prejudice, the affected portion may not be used as the basis for adverse action. The available referral paths include referring the entire case to a new investigative officer or board, or referring only the affected portion while acting on unaffected findings and recommendations.",
  "question": "What should the approval authority do about the substantial error while determining whether it can be corrected without substantial prejudice to the affected Individual?",
  "facts": [
    {
      "id": "F1",
      "kind": "authority",
      "status": "confirmed",
      "fact": "A substantial error is one that materially adversely affects an individual’s substantial rights.",
      "spans": ["src:031d24bb6581#p20.3"]
    },
    {
      "id": "F2",
      "kind": "authority",
      "status": "confirmed",
      "fact": "If a substantial error can be corrected without substantial prejudice, the approval authority may return the case to the same investigative officer or board for corrective action.",
      "spans": ["src:031d24bb6581#p20.3"]
    },
    {
      "id": "F3",
      "kind": "authority",
      "status": "confirmed",
      "fact": "Respondents affected by a return for corrective action are to be notified of the error and proposed correction and of their right to comment on both.",
      "spans": ["src:031d24bb6581#p20.3"]
    },
    {
      "id": "F4",
      "kind": "authority",
      "status": "confirmed",
      "fact": "If a substantial error cannot be corrected, or cannot be corrected without substantial prejudice, the approval authority may not use the affected part as the basis for adverse action against the individual.",
      "spans": ["src:031d24bb6581#p20.4"]
    },
    {
      "id": "F5",
      "kind": "authority",
      "status": "confirmed",
      "fact": "For an error that cannot be corrected without substantial prejudice, the approval authority may set aside all findings and recommendations and refer the entire case to a new investigative officer or board composed of entirely new voting members.",
      "spans": ["src:031d24bb6581#p20.4"]
    },
    {
      "id": "F6",
      "kind": "authority",
      "status": "confirmed",
      "fact": "Alternatively, the approval authority may act on findings and recommendations unaffected by the error, set aside affected findings and recommendations, and refer the affected portion to a new investigative officer or board.",
      "spans": ["src:031d24bb6581#p20.4"]
    },
    {
      "id": "F7",
      "kind": "authority",
      "status": "confirmed",
      "fact": "A new investigative officer or board may be furnished evidence properly considered by the previous one and may also consider additional evidence.",
      "spans": ["src:031d24bb6581#p20.4"]
    }
  ],
  "options": {
    "O1": {
      "do": "The approval authority returns the case to the same investigative officer or board for corrective action and notifies affected respondents of the error, proposed correction, and right to comment.",
      "move": "act",
      "disposition": "return",
      "irreversible": false
    },
    "O2": {

    },

      "move": "act",

      "irreversible": false
    }
  },
